Bike Night Reno

Reno, NV · Downtown

Beginner friendly

Bike Night Reno is a social group ride in Reno, NV. It meets every Wednesday, show up 7:45 pm, roll about 8:15 pm, starting at Reno City Plaza (Believe sign / Space Whale). Pace: social.

About the Bike Night Reno group ride

A weekly downtown social night ride that meets at the Believe sign in City Plaza. Everyone is welcome, any bike. Routes are on the group's Strava club. Listed on the Reno Wheelmen calendar.
